about: Cell-role labels for a sample of European open-data sheets (testdata/irregular/eu_*). Sheets were chosen by tools/benchmarks/select_eu_sheets.py; labels were written by an AI assistant reading the cells the hedgehog reader sees (`hedgehog cells`), before running hedgehog on them, and have not yet been reviewed by a person. build_eu_labels.py expands them into testdata/irregular/eu_labelled/labels.tsv.
format: Per sheet, `labels` is a list of A1 ranges (or `*` = every cell) with a role, applied in order; later ranges override earlier ones. Only non-empty cells get a label, and every non-empty cell must end up with one.
conventions: header: every row of a column header, including stub-head cells (`Jahr`, `WYSZCZEGÓLNIENIE`), spanning labels over several columns, unit rows inside the header (`%`, `Mrd. EUR`) and column-number rows (`1 2 3`).
data: row labels / stub columns, codes, category columns that repeat down the table, and continuation lines of a wrapped or translated row label (`public sector` under `sektor publiczny`).
group_header: a label alone on its row that starts a section of the table (`eingeleitet durch`, `Hombres`, `ANNO ACCADEMICO 2019/2020`).

total: a whole row (label and values) that the sheet marks as a total (Total, Totale, Insgesamt, Summe, Ogółem, i alt, samlet, Geheel - Totaal, TOTALES, an unlabelled sum row at the end), or an aggregate of the listed units (country above or below its regions, macro-regions after Italian regions, the EU row, annual averages after the twelve months). Total columns stay data. Parent rows of an indented hierarchy that carry no total wording stay data (they are categories, not summary rows), even where their values happen to be sums.
title: text above a table that names it, including subtitles, year lines, unit lines (`Unidades: Tasas`), publisher lines at the top and table codes on the title row.
note: footnotes, sources, `Stand`/as-of dates, copyright and contact lines, URLs, explanatory paragraphs and metadata blocks below or beside a table.
other: navigation links (`zur Inhaltsübersicht`, `Powrót do spisu tablic`, `Overzicht`) and stray cells away from the table.
